You could beat most people at anything
if you just don't quit when it gets boring. Not hard, boring. That's where
everyone else stops because wealth is made by doing boring things for an
extended period of time in more volume than any sane person would find
reasonable. The world belongs to those who can keep fighting after realizing
winning won't be fast, easy, or guaranteed.
